statement: A line-based check over a parsed format is sound only if it splits lines exactly as the parser does. Refuse any input where the two could disagree, before skipping lines as comments. 2026-11-09, #687, my own error: to compare an Action's runs: section byte for byte, I made the validator split on \n and skip lines starting with #. GitHub's runner parses action.yml with YamlDotNet 5.3.0, whose IsBreak also treats a lone CR, NEL (U+0085), LS (U+2028) and PS (U+2029) as line breaks. Text after one of them inside an apparent comment was live YAML. Round-4 review hid a whole step, a shell line, an env PATH and an if: false that way, and the validator passed all of them. Fix (#687): before any comparison, refuse those characters, other control characters, a document marker and a second runs: key. All eleven hiding variants are now refused.
